verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is an API endpoint that starts an automation for a specific contact, which covers manually entering or re-entering one person. Nothing shows where a contact sits in an automation or how to remove them without disrupting the flow. Missing for 10: per-contact automation position visibility, the ability to pull or exit a contact from an automation, safe re-entry semantics, and any UI-level ops tooling or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow

citations.quote: Start an automation for a specific contact.
